description: Create a swatch (Swatches panel menu > New Color Swatch, New Tint Swatch, New Mixed Ink Swatch, New Mixed Ink Group): a process or spot colour from RGB, CMYK or Lab values, a tint of a colour, a mixed ink from ink percentages, or a mixed ink group stepping ink percentages; optionally named with its colour values and placed in a colour group

baseColor.description: Tint: the colour swatch the tint is made from

group.description: Put the new swatch in this colour group (created if it does not exist)

inks.description: Mixed ink or mixed ink group: the inks (at least one spot ink); names as set_inks lists them, e.g. "Process Cyan" or a spot colour name

increment.description: Mixed ink group: percentage added at each step

percent.description: Percentage of the ink (mixed ink), or its initial percentage (mixed ink group)

repeat.description: Mixed ink group: how many more steps to generate for this ink

kind.description: What to create: a colour, a tint, a mixed ink or a mixed ink group

model.description: Color Type of a colour: process (printed from CMYK) or spot (its own ink plate). Default process

name.description: Swatch name (colours, unless nameWithColorValue; required for mixed inks and groups; tints are named after their base colour)

nameWithColorValue.description: Name the colour from its values, e.g. "C=0 M=100 Y=0 K=0" (Swatch Options > Name with Color Value)

space.description: Color Mode of a colour: rgb, cmyk or lab

tint.description: Tint: percentage of the base colour

values.description: Colour values in the chosen space: RGB 0-255 each; CMYK 0-100 each; Lab L 0-100, a and b -128 to 127

name: create_swatch
title: Create Swatch
